title: Basic Conditionals: First Conditional
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has dominado el Primer Condicional. Ahora puedes hablar de causas y efectos futuros en los negocios: si pasa A, sucederá B.

parts.visual: Usamos el Primer Condicional para hablar de situaciones futuras posibles y sus resultados. Estructura: If + Presente Simple, sujeto + will + verbo.
parts.audio: We use the First Conditional to talk about possible future situations and their results. Structure: If plus Present Simple, then subject plus will plus verb.

parts.visual: Ejemplos: If we reduce the price, sales will increase (Si reducimos el precio, las ventas aumentarán). If it rains, I will stay at the office (Si llueve, me quedaré en la oficina).
parts.audio: Examples: If we reduce the price, sales will increase. If it rains, I will stay at the office. The 'if' clause is the condition, the 'will' clause is the result.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para completar el condicional.

questions.question: If we reduce the price, sales ____ increase. (Aumentarán).
If she ____ the contract, we will start the project. (Firma).
questions.explanation: Cláusula 'If' lleva Presente Simple: she signs.

questions.question: If it rains, I ____ stay at the office. (Me quedaré).
If they don't agree, we ____ cancel the deal. (Cancelaremos).
I will call you if I ____ more information. (Necesito).
questions.explanation: Cláusula 'If' lleva Presente Simple: I need. (El orden puede invertirse: Resultado + If).

questions.question: If the client ____, tell him I am in a meeting. (Llama).
We ____ lose the client if we are late. (Perderemos).
If you ____ hard, you will get a promotion. (Trabajas).
If the server crashes, we ____ lose the data. (Perderemos).
He will fail the audit if he ____ prepare. (No se prepara).
questions.explanation: Negativo en presente simple para he: doesn't prepare.

questions.question: If we launch the product early, we ____ gain market share. (Ganaremos).
What ____ you do if they say no? (¿Qué harás...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta de resultado: What will you do...?

questions.question: If I ____ time, I will review the document. (Tengo).
If she is late, the manager ____ be angry. (Estará).
We won't finish if you ____ help us. (No ayudas).
questions.explanation: If you don't help (Presente simple negativo).

questions.question: If the price is too high, customers ____ buy it. (No comprarán).
questions.explanation: Resultado negativo = will not / won't buy.

questions.question: If we ____ the deadline, there will be a penalty. (Incumplimos / Miss).
I will email you if the meeting ____. (Cambia).
If you need help, I ____ assist you. (Te ayudaré).
They will invest if the business plan ____ good. (Es).
questions.explanation: If it is (Presente simple del verbo to be).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'will', 'won't' o el verbo en presente según corresponda.

questions.question: If we reduce the price, sales ____ increase.
If she ____ the contract, we will start. (Firma).
If it rains, I ____ stay at the office.
I will call you if I ____ more info. (Necesito).
If the client ____, tell him. (Llama).
If you ____ hard, you will get it. (Trabajas).
He will fail if he ____ prepare. (No se prepara).
What ____ you do if they say no?
We won't finish if you ____ help us. (No ayudas).
If the price is high, they ____ buy it. (No comprarán).

pairs.source: I will call you if I need info

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.
options: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.
If they reduce the price, sales will increase.
If we reduce the price, sales might increase.
If we change the price, sales will increase.
questions.correct_answer: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If she signs the contract, we will start the project.
options: If she signs the contract, we will start the project.
If he signs the contract, we will start the project.
If she signs the contract, they will start the project.
If she signed the contract, we would start the project.
questions.correct_answer: If she signs the contract, we will start the project.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If it rains, I will stay at the office.
options: If it rains, I will stay at the office.
If it rains, she will stay at the office.
If it rains, I will work at the office.
If it rains, I stay at the office.
questions.correct_answer: If it rains, I will stay at the office.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I will call you if I need more information.
options: I will call you if I need more information.
She will call you if she needs more information.
I will email you if I need more information.
I will call you if I have more information.
questions.correct_answer: I will call you if I need more information.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If the client calls, tell him.
options: If the client calls, tell him.
If the client calls, tell her.
If a client calls, tell him.
If the manager calls, tell him.
questions.correct_answer: If the client calls, tell him.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We will lose the client if we are late.
options: We will lose the client if we are late.
They will lose the client if they are late.
We might lose the client if we are late.
We will lose the project if we are late.
questions.correct_answer: We will lose the client if we are late.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What will you do if they say no?
options: What will you do if they say no?
What will she do if they say no?
What will you do if we say no?
What would you do if they said no?
questions.correct_answer: What will you do if they say no?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We won't finish if you don't help us.
options: We won't finish if you don't help us.
They won't finish if you don't help them.
We wouldn't finish if you didn't help us.
We won't finish if she doesn't help us.
questions.correct_answer: We won't finish if you don't help us.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If you work hard, you will get a promotion.
options: If you work hard, you will get a promotion.
If she works hard, she will get a promotion.
If you study hard, you will get a promotion.
If you work hard, you might get a promotion.
questions.correct_answer: If you work hard, you will get a promotion.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Customers won't buy it if the price is high.
options: Customers won't buy it if the price is high.
Customers won't buy it if the price is too high.
People won't buy it if the price is high.
Customers wouldn't buy it if the price was high.
questions.correct_answer: Customers won't buy it if the price is high.
